src.title: 3 Epic Stuffed Baguettes That Will Blow Your Mind

recipes.title: Toad-in-the-Hole Breakfast Baguette (eggs, bacon & cheddar)
steps: Hollow
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Cut 5 evenly spaced holes in the top of the baguette and scoop out some of the inside.
Fill
Cook the diced bacon until crisp and divide it between the holes, then sprinkle cheddar into each.
Bake
Crack an egg into each hole and bake about 15 minutes, until the whites are set (longer for firm yolks).
recipes.notes: Recipe from the creator's description; macros are estimated per egg section.

recipes.title: Bacon-Wrapped Pepperoni Cheese Baguette
steps: Split
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Slice the baguette lengthwise, keeping the top and bottom attached.
Layer

Spread mayo on the bottom, add 1/3 of the pepperoni, half the mozzarella, another 1/3 pepperoni, half the ketchup and the American cheese. Spread the rest of the ketchup and mayo, add the remaining pepperoni and mozzarella, and close.
Wrap
Lay the bacon in one long, overlapping double row, set the baguette on top and wrap the bacon around it from both sides.
Bake
Bake for 45 minutes until the bacon is crisp. Slice to serve.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the creator's description; macros are estimated per slice (8). Very indulgent, best for sharing.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage Meatball Sub Boat
steps: Meatballs
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Mix the sausage with the garlic powder, pepper, basil, grated parmesan, egg and breadcrumbs. Shape into meatballs and fry in olive oil until golden.
Simmer
Add the marinara and simmer about 15 minutes.
Boat
Cut a long rectangle out of the top of the baguette and scoop out the inside.
Fill & bake
Sprinkle in half the mozzarella and all the shredded parmesan, add the meatballs and sauce, top with the remaining mozzarella and bake 25 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the creator's description; macros are estimated per quarter.
